title: Material for MkDocs feature flags
description: The entries of the theme.features sequence of the Material for MkDocs theme.

id.description: The identifier as it appears in theme.features, for example navigation.tabs.

group.description: The section of the page this flag changes.

descriptionKey.description: The bundle key of the one line description shown in QuickDoc, completion and the settings page.

docUrl.description: The address of the section of the Material for MkDocs documentation describing this flag, linked from QuickDoc.

insiders.description: Whether the flag only has an effect in an Insiders build of the theme.

requires.description: The ids of the flags that have to be enabled as well for this flag to do anything.

conflictsWith.description: The ids of the flags this one cannot be combined with. Declared on one side only; the symmetric closure is computed when the file is read.

requiredExtensions.description: The markdown extension ids that have to be enabled for this flag to work.
